findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - CI runs either shell parameter of test_1. The fresh client's init installs Git hooks (src/forge/init.py:356), but this helper creates fix/feature-guidance directly without a Forge state record. The commit here therefore fails: pre_commit rejects unregistered branches (src/forge/githooks.py:128), so the worker brief assertions never run. The subsequent push to main at line 364 is independently refused by pre_push (src/forge/githooks.py:157); the adopted fixture also installs these hooks through sync. Prepare the fixture history with hooks explicitly disabled for those setup operations, while retaining the real forge work call being tested.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_a_plan_line_builds_the_feature_in_one_step
